Question
========
What prefetcher looks for a constant pattern in the memory accesses?


Answerlist
----------
* Stream Prefetcher
* Pattern Prefetcher
* Stride Prefetcher
* Jump Prefetcher

Solution
========
The stride prefetcher detects that the accesses are separated by a constant distance, for instance when walking an array of structures, and issues the next addresses of the same arithmetic progression.

Answerlist
----------
* 0. The stream prefetcher follows sequential accesses in a single direction.
* 0. This is not the name used for this hardware prefetcher.
* 1. It detects a constant stride between accesses and continues the progression.
* 0. This is not one of the prefetchers seen in the course.
